title: Minimal Read Device Identification via Encapsulated Interface Transport
purpose: Exercise function 0x2B with MEI type 0x0E Read Device Identification using a compact valid nested request.
expected_behavior: Server should parse a valid MBAP-framed function 0x2B request carrying MEI type 0x0E Read Device Identification, then respond with identification data or a standard exception if unsupported.
constraints_preserved: length is 0x0005, matching unit_id plus 4-byte PDU.
Function code 0x2B is used for Encapsulated Interface Transport.
Nested fields are MEI type 0x0E, Read Device ID code 0x01, and object id 0x00.
issue_safety_notes: No issue enhancement is used. This is a small, valid nested request chosen for parser-depth coverage.
